notes.title: ULTIMATE CHALLENGE UPDATE (Game Update #5)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Hardcore Mode: Test your skills across all six levels a new difficulty mode with tougher enemies and challenges!
[*] Golden Cartridges: Find hidden collectables spread across all levels to unlock super-secret content! Rumor has it that something special might happen at the end of the game...
[*] New Ripped Boost ability: This special move makes Dot super powerful when she gathers enough pixels and allows hardcore players and speed-runners to devise new strategies for clearing each level.
[*] Dot outfits: Unlock new armors for Dot that give bragging rights to true Pixel Ripped fans!
[*] Pixel Doors: Explore alternative routes that will only open for the best players!
[*] Interactive comic book: A fully original Pixel Ripped story added to David's room.
[*] New after-credits scene for all players.
[*] Score System and Level Records: Brag about your best score and time on each level!
[*] Cut-scene Skip and built-in gameplay timer to improve the speed-running / time-trial experience.
[*] Several bug fixes and improvements for the overall experience.
[/list]

Watch the update trailer here - https://youtu.be/-xHtgcGgWkw

notes.title: Game Update!
notes.notes:
We’ve been hard at work to resolve issues that users reported and to overall polish and improve the game! More updates and features coming soon. In this update: 
- Fixed Achievements Bug: Users were unable to unlock any of the achievements
- Polished Implementation of Valve Index Controllers: Some users had issues with advancing dialogue while holding the grab button. 
- Fixed Dot Underwater gravity 
- Bug: Some users reported that after a few deaths during the water level, Dot would lose her gravity, making it impossible to progress. 
- Analytics Implementation: To help us improve your game experience, we are collecting anonymous data about gameplay through Unity Analytics such as which checkpoints players are struggling the most. This data will help us to better understand critical issues of the game and make better design choices in future updates. We respect your privacy and if you are not comfortable with sharing your data, you can opt out by clicking on the Privacy Settings in the in-game menu and following the instructions on your browser. 

If you have any questions please feel free to connect with us on DISCORD: 
https://discord.gg/6JNVSn9
